_comment: Expansion 3 part E.3: spells outside battle - finding and seeing, asking the powers, talking (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md). Numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook, checked on the page images (build/e3_facts.json while building). Finding, seeing and asking are game/divining.py; talking is game/speech.py; the lasting ones (Comprehend Languages, Tongues, Speak with Animals, Rary's Telepathic Bond) are buffs read outside a fight.

detect_magic.name: Detect Magic
detect_magic.text: For ten minutes you sense magic within 30 feet: the strange things in your packs show their aura and its school, and chests near you that hold magic glow on the map. Stone a foot thick stops it.

detect_evil_and_good.name: Detect Evil and Good
detect_evil_and_good.text: For ten minutes you sense aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead within 30 feet, unless a foot of stone lies between, and whether the ground here is hallowed or haunted.

detect_poison_and_disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
detect_poison_and_disease.text: For ten minutes you sense poison and sickness within 30 feet: a fever still hidden in one of you, food or water gone foul, a poisoned trap, a venomous creature.

find_traps.name: Find Traps
find_traps.text: You sense every trap within 120 feet that you can see the way to, and what kind of danger each is, though not where it lies: searching for them and saving against them has Advantage.

locate_object.name: Locate Object
locate_object.text: For ten minutes you sense the way to a thing within 1,000 feet: a chest on this level, a dragon's hoard, or the thing your work sends you to find. Lead hides it.

locate_creature.name: Locate Creature
locate_creature.text: For an hour you sense the way to a creature within 1,000 feet: the one your work is about, a captive, the master of this place, or someone you have met in this town.

locate_animals_or_plants.name: Locate Animals or Plants
locate_animals_or_plants.text: You learn the way and the distance to the nearest game, herbs or beast you name within 5 miles: hunting or foraging has +5 for half a day, and a beast your work hunts is found.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
clairvoyance.text: An unseen eye opens in the nearest places you have not yet seen, behind a door or round a corner, within a mile: you see them, and whoever waits there.

arcane_eye.name: Arcane Eye
arcane_eye.text: An invisible eye floats from you and slips through every gap for an hour: the whole level is mapped, but what lies behind secret doors, and the bands in it are seen.

scrying.name: Scrying
scrying.text: You watch someone of the world (a Wisdom save; easier for one you only heard of, harder for one you met): you learn where they are now. On a success you cannot try them again for a day.

beast_sense.name: Beast Sense
beast_sense.text: For an hour you see and hear through one of your animals as it ranges ahead: you see a band on the road before it sees you.

drawmijs_instant_summons.name: Drawmij's Instant Summons

material.text: a sapphire worth 1,000+ GP, crushed when you call the thing

drawmijs_instant_summons.text: You mark something you carry (10 pounds or less) and write its name in a sapphire. Crush the sapphire later and it is in your hand, wherever robbers or the watch put it; one sold or given away stays.

augury.name: Augury
augury.text: An omen on what you mean to do next: weal, woe, both or neither. Each casting after the first before a long rest is 25% likelier to bring no answer.

divination.name: Divination

material.text: incense worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

divination.text: One question about a work in hand, answered truly: whether it is as you were told, and where its quarry is. Each casting after the first before a long rest is 25% likelier to bring no answer.

commune.name: Commune
commune.text: Your god answers three questions with yes or no, truly: the one you choose and the two weighing most on you. Each casting after the first before a long rest is 25% likelier to bring no answer.

commune_with_nature.name: Commune with Nature
commune_with_nature.text: The spirits of the land tell you what lies within 3 miles (300 feet under the ground): towns and ruins, water, the game and herbs, and the worst creature near. Not among buildings.

contact_other_plane.name: Contact Other Plane
contact_other_plane.text: A DC 15 Intelligence save: on a success a mind from beyond answers five questions in a word; on a failure 6d6 psychic and you lie senseless until a long rest.

legend_lore.name: Legend Lore

material.text: incense worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth 50+ GP each

legend_lore.text: The lore of someone, somewhere or something famous comes to you: a storied thing you carry is known through and through; a lost artifact's resting place, a beast's lair and what harms it.

comprehend_languages.name: Comprehend Languages
comprehend_languages.text: For an hour you understand any tongue you hear: a band that shares no language with you can still be talked past, though it is harder (+5).

tongues.name: Tongues
tongues.text: For an hour the one you touch understands every tongue and is understood by anyone who speaks one: words on the road go as if you shared a language.

speak_with_animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak_with_animals.text: For ten minutes you talk with beasts: hungry animals on the road can be talked past, and the beasts tell you of the places and the monsters near.

speak_with_dead.name: Speak with Dead
speak_with_dead.text: A corpse from your last fight answers five questions: where its band keeps its lair, who sent it, what it knew. Not the undead, nor one asked in the last ten days.

speak_with_plants.name: Speak with Plants
speak_with_plants.text: The grass and trees tell you what passed here in the last day: you know the band that roams near and see it first, and they show you where food grows (+5 to forage).

message.name: Message
message.text: You whisper to someone you know who is out of sight but near, and hear their whispered answer: a companion waiting in the same town comes to you at once.

sending.name: Sending
sending.text: Twenty-five words to a companion waiting anywhere, heard in their mind: they set out to meet you where you stand.

animal_messenger.name: Animal Messenger
animal_messenger.text: A bird carries your words to a companion waiting within 50 miles, flying 50 miles a day: they set out to meet you where you stand.

dream.name: Dream
dream.text: You walk in a sleeper's dream: tell a companion far away to come to you, or terrify a named beast your work hunts (a Wisdom save, or 3d6 psychic and a night without rest: it meets you hurt).

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.text: A link of thought with a companion far away, wherever they are: they hear you at once and set out to meet you.

rarys_telepathic_bond.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
rarys_telepathic_bond.text: For an hour the party's minds are linked, over any distance: what one sees, all know, and while two or more are linked none of them is surprised.

detect_thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
detect_thoughts.text: In a fight you sense every thinking creature within 30 feet, the invisible and the hidden too. Outside one you read someone near you (a Wisdom save): what they feel, and what their work hides.
